_readme: Paste the `activity_report` object below into the project's .project.json, next to project_slug, project_name and ticket_provider. Then run `activity-report init` in the repo.
Every key is optional. A missing key takes the default in scripts/ar/config.py (DEFAULTS); the values here follow the james-brennan setup (its extra_repo_paths names the client-portal checkout).
enabled: false makes every subcommand exit 2 with 'nothing to do for this project'.
audiences: which reports to produce, in run order. internal first is the convention: the external pass reads the internal body.
timezone: an IANA zone. The window label (YYYY-MM-DDTHHMM) and the timer's OnCalendar use it.
extra_repo_paths: absolute paths of other checkouts whose commits belong to this project. The .project.json repo is always included; worktrees are found automatically.
schedule.at: HH:MM local time for the nightly timer. install-timer writes it into activity-report@<slug>.timer.d/schedule.conf.

window.cap_hours: the longest window one report covers; when the previous report is older than this, basis becomes cap_24h. window.min_minutes: a window shorter than this makes collect exit 4 (nothing to do) unless --force.

hindsight.bank: the memory bank name, null = the repo basename. hindsight.recall: read facts about the window into the digest. hindsight.retain: store the report (as prose, verified by memory_unit_count, retried on an empty extraction) after a successful emit. hindsight.retain_audiences: which audiences are written to memory; internal only by default, the client-facing text being spin rather than the record.

board.api_key_ref: an op:// reference for the board API key, never a value. board.exposure_labels: the two labels that mark a ticket client-visible (always surfaced) or internal-only (never named to the client). board.max_live_fetches: cap on per-ticket lookups per run.
compose.model: a model id passed as `claude --model`, null = the CLI default. compose.timeout_minutes: wall clock for one compose pass; the systemd unit allows 90 minutes for the whole run.

lint.extra_identifiers: more ticket prefixes the external lint refuses (a second board, a vendor's tracker). lint.banned_terms: words that must never reach the client, matched whole and case-insensitively.

output.runtime_dir: repo-relative and gitignored; digests, raw.txt, html, events and the lock live under <runtime_dir>/<slug>/. output.durable_html_dir: repo-relative and committed; one html per run lands there, null = no durable copy.

portal: null when the project has no client portal. Otherwise kind (only automatic-ai exists) and project_id, the portal's own project uuid. An external report becomes a client-visible row; an internal one, a team-only row.
